items.title: US rig count up five as prices rise
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up two this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 265 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 255 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is up five from last week at 593 rigs. A year ago, 539 rigs were active.
